title: 轉
teacherNotes: Production D asset-complete package for L328 轉. Approved sentences are fixed by Editor handoff. Latest origin/main production JSON is complete through L323 方, so L324 圖, L325 向, L326 線, and L327 直 remain dependencies and provisional learned characters until Release integrates them. Learner-facing allowed-character sweep covers text, spokenText, displayLines, focusChar, Stage 4 option text, G02 teach fragments, and G05 option text. Image notes and prompts are production instructions and are not part of the learned-character gate.

generationConstraints.allowedDisplayCharsBoundary: latest origin/main learned chars through production JSON L323 + provisionalLearnedChars 圖 向 線 直 + current new char 轉
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use the complete L058 lesson image set only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family continuity from docs/LESSON_VISUAL_CAST_SOP.md and docs/CURRICULUM_LEDGER.md.
No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, signs, labels, logos, brands, subtitles, readable marks, direction labels, compass letters, or watermarks anywhere.
Natural directional cues and simple abstract map route lines are allowed, but do not rely on written labels.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
Before accepting final exported WebP images, review them side-by-side against the L058 style anchors and relevant cast anchors; regenerate if style or recurring cast continuity drifts.

approvedSentences.text: 看地圖上的路線，直走再左轉。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 看地圖上的路線直走再左轉
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist girl identity and recurring protagonist father identity. The girl and father stand at an outdoor road intersection, looking at a simple map together. The map has one clear non-text route line that goes straight ahead first and then turns left. The father points at the map, and the girl is ready to follow the route. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, direction words, compass letters, or watermarks.

Remote-control car scene. Use the recurring protagonist girl identity. The girl holds a remote controller, and a small toy car on the floor is visibly turning left because she is using the controller. The picture must show the child using the remote to make the car turn left, not a random spinning car. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, direction words, or watermarks.

Outdoor grass or yard scene with a colorful pinwheel as the main subject. Wind is blowing, and the pinwheel is visibly spinning continuously with gentle motion cues. The recurring protagonist girl may stand nearby watching, but the pinwheel turning must remain the clear subject. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, or watermarks.

approvedSentences.text: 小狗轉身，跑向沒人的地方。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 小狗轉身跑向沒人的地方
approvedSentences.imageNotes: A small friendly dog in a home entrance or park scene is turning its body away from a small group or noisy area and running toward an empty quiet patch. The image must clearly show the dog turning around and moving toward a place with no people. Keep the scene calm and safe. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, or watermarks.

approvedSentences.text: 轉動把手，就可以把線收回來。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 轉動把手就可以把線收回來
approvedSentences.imageNotes: Use the recurring protagonist girl identity in an outdoor grassy kite-flying scene. She holds a kite string reel with a handle and turns the handle to wind the line back in. A kite is visible in the sky, with the line safely connected to the reel in her hands. The meaning-bearing focus is turning the handle and pulling the line back in. Do not show tangled line around a person or dangerous motion. No visible text, letters, numbers, Chinese characters, zhuyin, labels, signs, logos, or watermarks.
